summary.purpose: Button is a component family for action controls. Apollo should treat Button variant changes as component property changes and manual style/token/layout changes as layer customizations.

auditInterpretation.baselinePolicy: If a component property changed, compare manual layer overrides against the current actual component state baseline, not against the original reference state baseline.

exampleInterpretations.agentShouldSay: Apollo found a component property customization: view primary -> accent.
exampleInterpretations.agentShouldNotSay: The fill changed from Primary color unless Apollo also reports an explicit layer fill change.

exampleInterpretations.case: variant.View Primary -> Accent plus manual fill
exampleInterpretations.agentShouldSay: Show both changes: view primary -> accent, and fill from Accent baseline -> actual custom value.
exampleInterpretations.agentShouldNotSay: Compare the manual fill against Primary baseline.

exampleInterpretations.agentShouldSay: Apollo found a Button contract violation: text style on Label or Hint must match the effective Button baseline.
exampleInterpretations.agentShouldNotSay: This is only a component state change or an allowed layer customization.
